title: Define precedence when a pack resource is ALSO shipped at plugin root (watch dual-copy)
description:
Raised as a MEDIUM by the TASK-180 gating review (reviewer, full depth, 2026-07-29). TASK-180 shipped the `watch` skill at plugin-root `skills/` while deliberately leaving the addon-pack resource intact, so `watch` is now delivered through two independent channels with no rule stating which wins.

Consumer-visible consequence: a project that has run `pack-ctl reconcile-apply` carries `.claude/skills/watch/` (loads as `/watch`) AND receives the plugin's `skills/watch/` (loads as `/hivemind:watch`). The two are byte-identical today, so nothing is broken right now.

The divergence arrives on the next release that re-pins `watch`: the plugin copy advances with the plugin version, while the project copy stays frozen at whatever pin `integrations.lock.json` recorded until someone re-runs reconcile. The consumer then has two near-identically-named skills at different versions of pinned third-party code, and neither the reconciler nor the docs say which is authoritative. A user typing `/watch` vs `/hivemind:watch` would silently get different code.

Note why the obvious fix is wrong: simply dropping the pack resource makes the reconciler compute a REMOVE op against every project whose lockfile already owns `skill:watch`, deleting a working skill out from under existing consumers. TASK-180 avoided this deliberately (see its close comment) — any solution here must handle already-installed projects, not just new ones.

Candidate directions (decide, do not assume):
1. Teach the reconciler to skip — or actively retire — a project-scope resource when the plugin ships the same resource id at an equal-or-newer pin, with the lockfile edge released cleanly rather than left dangling.
2. Keep both channels but define and DOCUMENT precedence, plus a way for a consumer to see which copy is active and at what pin.
3. Reverse TASK-180's direction: make plugin-root shipping the only channel and give the pack a one-time migration path that retires the project copy without a bare REMOVE.

This is a design decision about the reconciler contract, so it needs a human call on the direction before implementation. Investigate first, propose, then implement the chosen option.
acceptance_criteria: The precedence rule between a plugin-root-shipped resource and the same resource installed project-scope via integrations.lock.json is decided by the human and recorded in writing (docs/design/addon-packs.md or the pack-descriptor docs), including which copy is authoritative when the pins differ

The chosen behavior is implemented in src/pack-reconcile.js / src/pack-orchestrator.js and covered by specs, including the already-installed-project case (a lockfile that already owns skill:watch must NOT be left with a dangling edge, and must NOT silently lose a working skill)
A regression spec proves the specific divergence scenario: plugin ships watch at pin B while a project lockfile owns watch at older pin A — assert the documented precedence actually holds end to end
`/hivemind:design-pack` and any reconcile-facing docs state what a consumer should expect when both copies are present, and how to tell which is active
npm run test:all is green and no existing pack/reconcile/assimilate spec regresses
